translations.web: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
translations.bsb: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
translations.kjv: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
translations.asv: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
